FAIL_TO_PASS: return-statements: breaks control flow when a return statement is encountered
super-class-prototype-values: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when reading property values
optional-chaining-null-values: supports optional chaining for null values
track-async-arrow-function-return-value: tracks object mutations of async arrow function return values
preserve-for-of-iterable: preserves for...of loops
supports-core-js: supports core-js
simplify-class-expression-assignment: wraps class expressions in call expressions in simplified assignments
simplify-function-expression-assignment: wraps function expressions in call expressions in simplified assignments
supports-es6-shim: supports es6-shim
deconstructed-exported-vars: allows destructuring in exported variable declarations, synthetic or otherwise
support-using-keyword: Support `using` keyword
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
tree-shake-iterable: retain functions that accept a iterable that has side effects on iteration
deshadowed-shorthand-property: shorthand properties referencing deshadowed variables are expanded
simplify-object-expression-assignment: wraps object expressions in call expressions in simplified assignments
object-tree-shaking-for-parameter: preserve the object argument
track-awaited-object: tracks object mutations through await
recursive-this-deoptimization: handles recursive "this" deoptimizations (#4089)
unary-expressions-preserve-constants: Preserves constant identifiers in unary expressions when constants are used elsewhere
super-class-prototype-calls: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when calling properties
